definition.text: The process carried out by a cell that restores the biological activity of an unfolded or misfolded protein, using helper proteins such as chaperones.

synonyms.name: heat shock protein activity

results.name: obsolete unfolded protein binding

definition.text: OBSOLETE. Binding to an unfolded protein.

results.comment: The reason for obsoletion is that this binding term should be replaced by an activity term such as protein folding chaperone (GO:0044183) or unfolded protein holdase activity (GO:0140309).

definition.text: The process of assisting in the correct noncovalent assembly of the ribosome-bound nascent chains of a multidomain protein whilst other parts of the protein are still being translated.

synonyms.name: 'de novo' co-translational protein folding
multidomain protein assembly
nascent polypeptide association

definition.text: Enables the transfer of a protein from one side of a membrane to the other.

synonyms.name: protein channel activity
protein transmembrane transporter activity

definition.text: Binding to a heat shock protein, a protein synthesized or activated in response to heat shock.

results.name: protein folding chaperone

definition.text: Binding to a protein or a protein-containing complex to assist the protein folding process.

results.comment: Note that a protein folding chaperone binds an unfolded protein to fold it. Do not confuse with unfolded protein holdase activity, which binds an unfolded protein and keeps it unfolded to deliver it to its final destination.

synonyms.name: chaperone activity
protein binding involved in protein folding

definition.text: Binding to a small conjugating protein such as ubiquitin or a ubiquitin-like protein.

synonyms.name: small conjugating protein binding
